Guest speaker shortlist — AcAff
notes:
Twelve candidates from the Guests tab of the AcAff calendar. Nobody is booked yet.

Nora Prior — Professor, Cornell (Psychology). Social sensory neurogenomics; connects social psychology to the hard neurosciences. Andy's PI.
Seema Golastaneh — Professor, Cornell (Anthropology). Can talk about Iran. Likely to come for free if asked.
Jill Collen Jefferson — Civil rights and international human rights attorney (UVA, Harvard Law). Police misconduct, unconstitutional policing, civil rights cold cases including modern-day lynchings.
Francis Fukuyama — Professor, Stanford, alumnus of the House. Will talk about consulting for Gaddafi.
Mildred Warner — Professor, Cornell (MRP). Community-based planning and development. Nominated by Mildred, seconded by Raaz.
Jitendra Malik — Professor of CS, UC Berkeley. Well-known computer vision professor.
Stephen Macedo — Laurance S. Rockefeller Professor of Politics, Princeton. Immigration, political disagreement, COVID mis- and disinformation. Knows the House through Alan Bloom and is keen to visit.
Stef Funk — Grassroots organizer, National Sustainable Agriculture Coalition. Food systems, government, policy and science from outside academia.
Lucinda Ramberg — Professor, Cornell (Anthropology and FGSS). New book on caste and sexuality out this year.
Lorenzo Alvisi — Professor and department chair, Cornell CS. Ran TASS with his wife; came to the faculty dinner last year.
Emily Lim Rogers — Professor, Duke (Cultural Anthropology). Politics of medicine in the US; Sick Work: Exhaustion, Labor, and Invisible Illness.
Naeem Inayatullah
